        DECLARE @action INT;
        SET @action = (
            SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
            FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.demandSignals')
        );

        DECLARE @payload TABLE (
            demandSignalId                  INT NULL,
            companyId                       INT NULL,
            channelId                       INT NULL,
            customerPhone                   NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            clientId                        INT NULL,
            marketingLeadAttributionId      INT NULL,
            concept                         NVARCHAR(30) NULL,
            origin                          NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            residenceZoneText               NVARCHAR(120) NULL,
            workZoneText                    NVARCHAR(120) NULL,

            preferredZoneLat                DECIMAL(9,6) NULL,
            preferredZoneLng                DECIMAL(9,6) NULL,
            frequency                       NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            preferredTime                   NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            currentSolution                 NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            painPoint                       NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
            wouldUse                        NVARCHAR(10) NULL,
            notifyOptIn                     BIT NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO @payload (demandSignalId, companyId, channelId, customerPhone, clientId, marketingLeadAttributionId, concept, origin, residenceZoneText, workZoneText, preferredZoneText, preferredZoneName, preferredZoneLat, preferredZoneLng, frequency, preferredTime, currentSolution, painPoint, wouldUse, notifyOptIn)

            TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.demandSignalId')),
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.channelId')),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.customerPhone'),
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.clientId')),
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.marketingLeadAttributionId')),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.concept'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.origin'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.residenceZoneText'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.workZoneText'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.preferredZoneText'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.preferredZoneName'),
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(9,6), JSON_VALUE(value, '$.preferredZoneLat')),
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(9,6), JSON_VALUE(value, '$.preferredZoneLng')),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.frequency'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.preferredTime'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.currentSolution'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.painPoint'),
            JSON_VALUE(value, '$.wouldUse'),
            TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.notifyOptIn'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.demandSignals');

        -- Validate for missing mandatory fields that are part of the UNIQUE constraint
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @payload WHERE companyId IS NULL OR customerPhone IS NULL OR concept IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Missing mandatory fields for upsert (companyId, customerPhone, concept).');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END;

        IF @action = 1 -- INSERT / UPSERT
        BEGIN
            MERGE dbo.demandSignals AS target
            USING (
                SELECT
                    p.companyId,
                    p.channelId,
                    p.customerPhone,
                    p.clientId,
                    p.marketingLeadAttributionId,
                    p.concept,
                    p.origin,
                    p.residenceZoneText,
                    p.workZoneText,
                    p.preferredZoneText,
                    p.preferredZoneName,
                    p.preferredZoneLat,
                    p.preferredZoneLng,
                    p.frequency,
                    p.preferredTime,
                    p.currentSolution,
                    p.painPoint,
                    p.wouldUse,
                    p.notifyOptIn
                FROM @payload AS p
            ) AS source
            ON (target.companyId = source.companyId AND target.customerPhone = source.customerPhone AND target.concept = source.concept)
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE SET
                    channelId                  = ISNULL(source.channelId, target.channelId),
                    clientId                   = ISNULL(source.clientId, target.clientId),
                    marketingLeadAttributionId = ISNULL(source.marketingLeadAttributionId, target.marketingLeadAttributionId),
                    origin                     = ISNULL(source.origin, target.origin),
                    residenceZoneText          = ISNULL(source.residenceZoneText, target.residenceZoneText),
                    workZoneText               = ISNULL(source.workZoneText, target.workZoneText),
                    preferredZoneText          = ISNULL(source.preferredZoneText, target.preferredZoneText),
                    preferredZoneName          = ISNULL(source.preferredZoneName, target.preferredZoneName),
                    preferredZoneLat           = ISNULL(source.preferredZoneLat, target.preferredZoneLat),
                    preferredZoneLng           = ISNULL(source.preferredZoneLng, target.preferredZoneLng),
                    frequency                  = ISNULL(source.frequency, target.frequency),
                    preferredTime              = ISNULL(source.preferredTime, target.preferredTime),
                    currentSolution            = ISNULL(source.currentSolution, target.currentSolution),
                    painPoint                  = ISNULL(source.painPoint, target.painPoint),
                    wouldUse                   = ISNULL(source.wouldUse, target.wouldUse),
                    notifyOptIn                = ISNULL(source.notifyOptIn, target.notifyOptIn),
                    optInAt                    = CASE WHEN target.notifyOptIn = 0 AND ISNULL(source.notifyOptIn, 0) = 1 THEN SYSUTCDATETIME() ELSE target.optInAt END,
                    intentLevel                = (
                                                 SELECT
                                                     CASE
                                                         WHEN ISNULL(source.wouldUse, target.wouldUse) = 'si' AND ISNULL(source.frequency, target.frequency) IN ('semanal','quincenal') AND ISNULL(source.notifyOptIn, target.notifyOptIn) = 1 THEN 'alta'
                                                         WHEN ISNULL(source.wouldUse, target.wouldUse) IN ('si','tal_vez') THEN 'media'
                                                         ELSE 'baja'
                                                     END
                                                ),
                    updated_at                 = SYSUTCDATETIME()
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                INSERT (
                    companyId, channelId, customerPhone, clientId, marketingLeadAttributionId, concept, origin, residenceZoneText, workZoneText, preferredZoneText, preferredZoneName, preferredZoneLat, preferredZoneLng, frequency, preferredTime, currentSolution, painPoint, wouldUse, notifyOptIn, optInAt, intentLevel, created_At
                )
                VALUES (
                    source.companyId, source.channelId, source.customerPhone, source.clientId, source.marketingLeadAttributionId, source.concept, source.origin, source.residenceZoneText, source.workZoneText, source.preferredZoneText, source.preferredZoneName, source.preferredZoneLat, source.preferredZoneLng, source.frequency, source.preferredTime, source.currentSolution, source.painPoint, source.wouldUse, source.notifyOptIn,
                    CASE WHEN ISNULL(source.notifyOptIn, 0) = 1 THEN SYSUTCDATETIME() ELSE NULL END, -- optInAt
                    CASE
                        WHEN source.wouldUse = 'si' AND source.frequency IN ('semanal','quincenal') AND ISNULL(source.notifyOptIn, 0) = 1 THEN 'alta'
                        WHEN source.wouldUse IN ('si','tal_vez') THEN 'media'
                        ELSE 'baja'
                    END, -- intentLevel
                    SYSUTCDATETIME()
                );

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated Successfully');
        END
        ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
        BEGIN
            DELETE ds
            FROM dbo.demandSignals AS ds
            INNER JOIN @payload AS p ON ds.demandSignalId = p.demandSignalId
            WHERE ds.companyId = p.companyId; -- Multi-tenancy check

        END

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Invalid action specified. Use 1 for upsert or 3 for delete.');
        END;

    END TRY

    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
    DECLARE @companyId INT;
    DECLARE @startDate DATETIME;
    DECLARE @endDate DATETIME;
    DECLARE @concept NVARCHAR(30);
    DECLARE @origin NVARCHAR(20);
    DECLARE @intentLevel NVARCHAR(10);
    DECLARE @sourceId INT; -- Corresponds to marketingLeadAttributionId

    SELECT
        @companyId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        @startDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.startDate')),
        @endDate   = TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.endDate')),
        @concept   = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.concept'),
        @origin    = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.origin'),
        @intentLevel = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.intentLevel'),
        @sourceId  = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.sourceId'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.demandSignals');

    SELECT TOP 500
        ds.demandSignalId,
        ISNULL(ds.companyId, 0)                                AS companyId,
        ISNULL(ds.channelId, 0)                                AS channelId,
        RIGHT(ds.customerPhone, 4)                             AS phoneLast4,
        ISNULL(ds.clientId, 0)                                 AS clientId,
        ISNULL(ds.marketingLeadAttributionId, 0)               AS marketingLeadAttributionId,
        ISNULL(ds.concept, '')                                 AS concept,
        ISNULL(ds.origin, '')                                  AS origin,
        ISNULL(ds.residenceZoneText, '')                       AS residenceZoneText,
        ISNULL(ds.workZoneText, '')                            AS workZoneText,
        ISNULL(ds.preferredZoneText, '')                       AS preferredZoneText,
        ISNULL(ds.preferredZoneName, '')                       AS preferredZoneName,
        ISNULL(ds.preferredZoneLat, 0)                         AS preferredZoneLat,
        ISNULL(ds.preferredZoneLng, 0)                         AS preferredZoneLng,
        ISNULL(ds.frequency, '')                               AS frequency,
        ISNULL(ds.preferredTime, '')                           AS preferredTime,
        ISNULL(ds.currentSolution, '')                         AS currentSolution,
        ISNULL(ds.painPoint, '')                               AS painPoint,
        ISNULL(ds.wouldUse, '')                                AS wouldUse,
        ISNULL(ds.notifyOptIn, 0)                              AS notifyOptIn,
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ds.optInAt, 126), '')      AS optInAt,
        ISNULL(ds.intentLevel, '')                             AS intentLevel,
        CASE WHEN ds.clientId IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(1 AS BIT) ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT) END AS isExistingClient,
        ISNULL(ds.marketingLeadAttributionId, 0)               AS sourceId,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ds.created_At, 126)               AS created_At,
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ds.updated_at, 126), '')   AS updated_at
    FROM dbo.demandSignals AS ds
    WHERE ds.companyId = @companyId
      AND (@startDate IS NULL OR DATEADD(HOUR, 7, ds.created_At) >= @startDate)
      AND (@endDate IS NULL OR DATEADD(HOUR, 7, ds.created_At) <= DATEADD(DAY, 1, @endDate)) -- End date is inclusive for the whole day
      AND (@concept IS NULL OR ds.concept = @concept)
      AND (@origin IS NULL OR ds.origin = @origin)
      AND (@intentLevel IS NULL OR ds.intentLevel = @intentLevel)
      AND (@sourceId IS NULL OR ds.marketingLeadAttributionId = @sourceId)
    ORDER BY ds.created_At DESC
    WHERE [companyId] = @companyId
    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('demandSignals');
END;

GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_demandSignals_zoneSummary]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
    DECLARE @companyId INT;
    DECLARE @startDate DATETIME;
    DECLARE @endDate DATETIME;
    DECLARE @concept NVARCHAR(30);
    DECLARE @origin NVARCHAR(20);

    SELECT
        @companyId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        @startDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.startDate')),
        @endDate   = TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.endDate')),
        @concept   = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.concept'),
        @origin    = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.origin')
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.demandSignals');

    WITH FilteredSignals AS (
        SELECT
            ds.companyId,
            ds.customerPhone,
            ds.concept,
            ds.preferredZoneName,
            ds.preferredZoneLat,
            ds.preferredZoneLng,
            ds.intentLevel,
            ds.frequency,
            ds.preferredTime,
            ds.clientId,
            ds.notifyOptIn
        FROM dbo.demandSignals AS ds
        WHERE ds.companyId = @companyId
          AND (@startDate IS NULL OR DATEADD(HOUR, 7, ds.created_At) >= @startDate)
          AND (@endDate IS NULL OR DATEADD(HOUR, 7, ds.created_At) <= DATEADD(DAY, 1, @endDate))
          AND (@concept IS NULL OR ds.concept = @concept)
          AND (@origin IS NULL OR ds.origin = @origin)
    ),
    OriginalZoneMetrics AS (
        SELECT
            fs.companyId,
            fs.concept,
            fs.preferredZoneName,
            fs.preferredZoneLat,
            fs.preferredZoneLng,
            COUNT(DISTINCT fs.customerPhone) AS people_in_zone
        FROM FilteredSignals AS fs
        GROUP BY
            fs.companyId,
            fs.concept,
            fs.preferredZoneName,
            fs.preferredZoneLat,
            fs.preferredZoneLng
    ),
    FoldedZoneMapping AS (
        SELECT
            ozm.companyId,
            ozm.concept,
            ozm.preferredZoneName,
            CASE WHEN ozm.people_in_zone < 3 THEN 'otras zonas' ELSE ozm.preferredZoneName END AS foldedZoneName,
            CASE WHEN ozm.people_in_zone < 3 THEN NULL ELSE ozm.preferredZoneLat END AS foldedLat,
            CASE WHEN ozm.people_in_zone < 3 THEN NULL ELSE ozm.preferredZoneLng END AS foldedLng
        FROM OriginalZoneMetrics AS ozm
    ),
    FinalAggregatedResults AS (
        SELECT
            fzm.foldedZoneName AS zoneName,
            fzm.foldedLat      AS lat,
            fzm.foldedLng      AS lng,
            fzm.concept,
            COUNT(DISTINCT fs.customerPhone) AS people,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.intentLevel = 'alta' THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS alta,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.intentLevel = 'media' THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS media,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.intentLevel = 'baja' THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS baja,
            CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.frequency IN ('semanal', 'quincenal') THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS DECIMAL(9,2)) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fs.customerPhone), 0) AS pctRecurring,
            (SELECT TOP 1 pt_final.preferredTime
             FROM FilteredSignals pt_final
             JOIN FoldedZoneMapping fzm_inner ON pt_final.companyId = fzm_inner.companyId AND pt_final.concept = fzm_inner.concept AND pt_final.preferredZoneName = fzm_inner.preferredZoneName
             WHERE fzm_inner.foldedZoneName = fzm.foldedZoneName AND fzm_inner.companyId = fzm.companyId AND fzm_inner.concept = fzm.concept
             GROUP BY pt_final.preferredTime
             ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pt_final.preferredTime) AS topPreferredTime,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.clientId IS NULL THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS newProspects,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.clientId IS NOT NULL THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS existingClients,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.notifyOptIn = 1 THEN fs.customerPhone END) AS optIns
        FROM FilteredSignals AS fs
        JOIN FoldedZoneMapping AS fzm ON fs.companyId = fzm.companyId AND fs.concept = fzm.concept AND fs.preferredZoneName = fzm.preferredZoneName
        GROUP BY
            fzm.companyId,
            fzm.concept,
            fzm.foldedZoneName,
            fzm.foldedLat,
            fzm.foldedLng
    )
    SELECT
        ISNULL(zoneName, '')                                   AS zoneName,
        ISNULL(lat, 0)                                         AS lat,
        ISNULL(lng, 0)                                         AS lng,
        ISNULL(concept, '')                                    AS concept,
        ISNULL(people, 0)                                      AS people,
        ISNULL(alta, 0)                                        AS alta,
        ISNULL(media, 0)                                       AS media,
        ISNULL(baja, 0)                                        AS baja,
        ISNULL(CAST(pctRecurring AS DECIMAL(5,2)), 0)          AS pctRecurring,
        ISNULL(topPreferredTime, '')                           AS topPreferredTime,
        ISNULL(newProspects, 0)                                AS newProspects,
        ISNULL(existingClients, 0)                             AS existingClients,
        ISNULL(optIns, 0)                                      AS optIns
    FROM FinalAggregatedResults
    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('demandSignals');
END;", "sp_one": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_demandSignals_one]
